facts.excerpt: Amangiri, meaning ‘peaceful mountain’ in Sanskrit, is set within what was originally national park land

facts.text: The architecture blends modern, sharp-angled concrete with the rugged desert landscape.
facts.excerpt: cleverly blending modern architecture—all sharp-angled concrete—with the rugged beauty of the desert to create a seamless harmony between nature and design

facts.text: The rooms are a contemporary interpretation of Native American shelters.
facts.excerpt: are a contemporary interpretation of Native American shelters, and keep you focused on the outdoors

facts.text: The terrace of the room described has an outdoor fireplace.
facts.excerpt: the terrace has an outdoor fireplace (perfect for toasting s’mores as the sun sets)

facts.text: Camp Sarika, a short walk from the main property, has tented pavilions next to the cliffs, each with its own plunge pool and a golf buggy.
facts.excerpt: At Camp Sarika—a short walk from the main property—10 tented pavilions sit nestled next to the cliffs. Each comes with its own plunge pool as well as a golf buggy for whizzing back and forth to the hotel.

facts.text: The cuisine mixes Mexican and Native American influences, using ingredients such as blue corn, green chilli and prickly pear.
facts.excerpt: Mexico meets Native American, showcasing ingredients such as blue corn, green chilli, and prickly pear.

facts.text: Most meals are eaten at the resort, which is all-inclusive.
facts.excerpt: expect to eat most meals at Amangiri—it’s all-inclusive.

facts.text: Each spa treatment begins with a white sage burning ritual, a local practice intended to cleanse and heal.
facts.excerpt: Each treatment begins with a white sage burning ritual—a local practice intended to cleanse and heal.

facts.text: Guests can explore slot canyons with a local Navajo guide.
facts.excerpt: a morning spent with Eli—a local Navajo guide who leads us through mind-blowing six-million-year-old slot canyons

facts.text: Educational stargazing sessions are organized in collaboration with a local observatory.
facts.excerpt: Educational stargazing sessions are on offer, which are organized in collaboration with a local observatory.

facts.text: The resort follows International Dark-Sky Association guidelines so that all property lighting minimizes light pollution.
facts.excerpt: The resort sticks to the International Dark-Sky Association's (IDA) guidelines, ensuring all lighting across the property is respectful of the night sky and minimizes light pollution.

facts.text: Amangiri is family-friendly, with books, games and pool toys available on request and a babysitting service.
facts.excerpt: Amangiri is family-friendly, with books, games, and pool toys available on request as well as a babysitting service.

facts.text: Much of the main hotel is accessible for wheelchair users, with ramps for the entrance and front desk, restaurant, pool, and spa and fitness center.
facts.excerpt: Much of the main hotel is accessible for wheelchair users, with ramps for the entrance and front desk, restaurant, pool, and spa/fitness center.

facts.text: The resort lists Page Municipal Airport (PGA) as a flight arrival option.
facts.excerpt: Flights flying into Page Municipal Airport (PGA)

facts.text: Guests flying into Phoenix Sky Harbor or Las Vegas Harry Reid airports then drive through scenery to reach the resort.
facts.excerpt: Approximately a 4.5 hours drive through beautiful scenery to reach Amangiri

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler lists Amangiri on its Gold List, including 2026.

contradictions.note: p1 says Page is a 25-minute drive, p3 says the transfer is a 20-minute drive

sources.excerpt: Page, AZ is a 25-minute drive from Amangiri
